notes: Focused single-competency task: drive llvm-link over separately emitted IR modules into one combined bitcode module resolving cross-file references, then link it with a C harness into a native executable. Failure modes probed: undefined symbols from a missed module (plugin.bc must have no undefined cross-module declares) and duplicate symbols from double-linking; link.sh must be generic for two hidden module sets with distinct call chains. Depends on a staged toolchain flow (link -> nm check -> compile+link -> run).
